findings: No active Meta ads under your name - five Hyderabad installers (Evergrid, Solox, Truzon, Punarvi, Twilight) are live this month buying the same homeowner with the same Rs. 78,000-subsidy message.

The site claims 13+ years, 50 MW+ delivered and 1500+ satisfied clients, with 15+ gated communities powered, a 1521-government-schools Telangana order and a 160 kW Corporate Bhavan (Ministry of Corporate Affairs) job. That proof exists - it is just not in front of paid traffic.
TGREDCO-empanelled (TSRE180027) with PM Surya Ghar and PM-KUSUM experience - credentials that convert homeowners who have already seen three competitor ads.

The site itself is in good shape: a multi-city quote form (Hyderabad, Secunderabad, Ranga Reddy, Medchal-Malkajgiri), a live chat widget, a WhatsApp button and a detailed residential page covering approvals, roof types and monitoring. Good raw material that no paid traffic ever sees.
Everything on the site is in English. In this market the strongest competitor creatives run in Telugu to the same homeowner - and your head office is here.
next_steps: Test paid lead gen in Hyderabad
Start with a small Meta budget on one residential offer - subsidy up to Rs. 78,000, free site visit. Your five competitors are already proving the demand exists in this city.
Build a dedicated residential landing page
The residential page exists - turn it into one paid landing page: subsidy, gated-community track record, free site visit, quote form on it.
Test a Telugu version of the offer against English. Telugu is the language of the Telangana homeowner, and your competitors are already spending there.
Put the government work to work
The 1521-schools order and the Corporate Bhavan job are strong proof for a trust-led paid campaign - most local installers cannot show that.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.

site_audit.platform: WordPress with the Bricks builder and Automatic CSS, Contact Form 7 plus the wpcf7-redirect plugin and a Google Sheets connector, Click to Chat for WhatsApp, locally-hosted Google Fonts
site_audit.html_errors: 38 errors, 2 warnings and 40 info messages on the homepage. The dominant defect is structural: the broken <noscript> element inside the <head> (the Meta Pixel fallback, source line 168) leaves the head unclosed, which cascades into a duplicate <body> start tag, stray end tags for head / div / header and 'End tag for body seen, but there were unclosed elements'. 24 of the 38 errors are style rules sitting outside an @scope rule, and the media queries still use the deprecated min-device-width / max-device-width syntax.
site_audit.scope_note: The complete <head> was read - source lines 1 to 399, ending at the favicon links - so the eight tracking rows are measured in both directions and a zero is a measurement. The rows that still read 'Not checked' are the ones the checker does not report and the source did not carry in readable form in this pass: the meta description length, the h1 count, the favicon, JSON-LD schema and the image alt-text counts. The body past source line 404 was not returned, so the footer scripts could not be read either.

issues: Your 9 live Google ads point at a homepage whose only tracking is a Meta Pixel that cannot fire: the pixel ID 1513606190140594 appears only inside a <noscript> image fallback at source line 168, and no fbq() initialisation script was read anywhere in the complete head. A visitor with JavaScript enabled - which is nearly all of them - is never counted.

There is no Google tag of any kind on the site: no GA4 measurement ID, no GTM container and no Google Ads conversion tag was read in the head. You are buying Search, Display, Local and YouTube clicks with no Google-side measurement behind them.

Your own site contradicts itself on size: the stat tiles claim '250+ MW Solar Capacity Engineered & Executed' and '1,500+ sites', while the About section of the same page says '13+ years in solar EPC and 50 MW+ of projects delivered'. Two capacity figures, five times apart, on one page.

The checker reports 38 errors on the homepage and the cause is your own pixel: the broken <noscript> in the head leaves the document with a duplicate <body>, stray end tags for head / div / header and 'End tag for body seen, but there were unclosed elements'.
og:site_name is empty and og:title is 'Home', so every share of your homepage on WhatsApp or Facebook is attributed to a page called 'Home' - the exact channel your ad spend is meant to feed.
No Google Ads / GTM tracking — can't measure ad performance
No Google Analytics — flying blind on website traffic

promise_gap: Google Ads Transparency: 9 live ads under advertiser AR03099108522298703873, verified as Four Solar Energy Systems Pvt. Ltd - including Local ads with DIRECTIONS and CALL buttons and image creatives headed 'Buy Solar Panels Online' and 'Buy Solar Panels for Homes'.

The Local ads carry empty rating stars and placeholder 'Open Hours' and 'Distance' fields - the ad format that leans on a Google Business Profile is running without a rated profile behind it. The click lands on a homepage with no Google-side tracking at all.
The ad copy promises 'Get Quality Pre and Post Solar Installation Services by Top Solar Rooftop Company in Hyd'.

The site substantiates the pre/post claim better than most: a 4-step process, a 'Book a Site Visit' page, a CF7 form that captures the monthly bill and zipcode, and a WhatsApp click-to-chat. What it cannot do is tell you which of those produced an enquiry, because nothing on the page is measured on the Google side.

The homepage presents '250+ MW Solar Capacity Engineered & Executed', '13+ years' and '1,500+ sites', with segments for Industrial & MSME, Commercial & Institutional, Ground-Mounted MW-Scale, PM-KUSUM, PM Surya Ghar, Gated Communities and Solar Kits, and a brand wall of Renew, Vikram, Pahal, Navgrun, Waaree and Solex.

The About section of the same page says '50 MW+ of projects delivered'. The six brand logos are shipped three times in a row, so the page reads as padded even where the underlying credentials are real.
